programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 2
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley’), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

programme.desc: Siaba Besar dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar dive site is a sheltered bay with coral seamounts and amazing coral reefs, located in the North-West side of the island. The reef is 4-6 meters deep with healthy corals and sand patches around. It has a massive coral garden and lacks strong currents, but it does not mean it lacks cool sights and marine life, just the opposite! This feature makes Siaba Besar a suitable dive site for any kind of level, being the best place for those who have never dived and want to try this amazing experience in Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar is heaven for snorkelers, given its easy conditions with shallow coral reefs, very little current and abundant marine life. A superlative snorkeling among sea turtles it is guaranteed, which gives the nickname to this site: Turtle City

programme.title: Dive Site Manta Point, Nusa Penida, Indonesia
programme.desc: In this episode, you will explore Manta Point, located in Nusa Penida, Bali, Indonesia, and learn about its remarkable marine inhabitants. Manta Point, situated on Nusa Penida's southwest coast, is renowned for its resident Manta ray colony, making it a must-visit dive site. Divers of all levels are drawn to its diverse range of underwater experiences, including reef exploration, photography, training, and fish identification. Notable species found here include the day octopus and the tawny nurse shark, both captivating creatures. Manta rays, particularly the Manta alfredi species, gracefully glide through the water with their distinctive pectoral fins and are often seen at cleaning stations, where cleaner fish help them rid parasites. However, these majestic creatures face threats from overfishing and human impacts. Manta Point offers an extraordinary underwater adventure, showcasing the beauty and diversity of marine life in this region.

programme.title: The Komodo dragons of south Rinca, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area is well known to be one of the best place to see wild Komodo dragons. The Komodo dragon (Varanus komodoensis), also known as the Komodo monitor, is a member of the monitor lizard family Varanidae that is endemic to the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang. It is the largest extant species of lizard, growing to a maximum length of 3 metres, and weighing up to approximately 70 kilograms. As a result of their size, Komodo dragons are apex predators, and dominate the ecosystems in which they live. Komodo dragons hunt and ambush prey including invertebrates, birds, and mammals. It has been claimed that they have a venomous bite; there are two glands in the lower jaw that secrete several toxic proteins. The biological significance of these proteins is disputed, but the glands have been shown to secrete an anticoagulant. Komodo dragons' group behavior in hunting is exceptional in the reptile world. The diet of Komodo dragons mainly consists of Javan rusa (Rusa timorensis), though they also eat considerable amounts of carrion. Komodo dragons also occasionally attack humans.

programme.title: Lawa Darat island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park. Also known as the “island close to the land” has a barren, desert savannah that changes color from green to yellow depending on the season. The island features easy hiking trails and two viewpoints to suit both spectacular sunrise and sunsets. Lawa Darat island is well protected from strong winds and waves, making the island the perfect spot for various activities to be carried out in safety. Some even refer to the island as the Komodo’s fjord, as attributed to its geological position. Besides, Lawa Darat island’s proximity to the ocean crossroads enables visitors to experience unexpected marine surprises such as encountering the humpback or the blue whale emerging majestically from the sea. The main attraction of Lawa Darat island is the scenic view that awaits visitors as they trek and reach the peak. This sole reason is what drives most Komodo National Park visitors to land on this island. Although beautiful all day long, the best recommended time to trek to the peak is sunset, when the breathtaking panoramic view calls for an Instagram selfie. The vantage point makes it perfect for capturing the beautiful beaches or the rolling hills catching rays of light. Trekking to the peak of the island might be considered as quite challenging for some, in particular, the beginners, but it is incredibly doable and worthwhile. The view is better and more beautiful as you trek higher where the reef becomes clearer while the mountainside begins to glow. Be ready for the remarkable panorama that awaits you at the top where the Komodo National Park lies in the opposite.

programme.title: Dive Site Manta Alley, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean. Manta Alley consists of a series of small rocky islands a few hundred meters away from the main island. There are several spots around these rocks where mantas can be found almost all year round. The site starts in a shallow reef close to the shore, where you can expect a strong to mild drift dive. You should keep your eyes wide open just as you enter the water, as mantas can be often found right in the shallows. Manta Rays are coming to this area for mating and cleaning purposes, where small wrasse and butterfly fish clean the mantas of parasites. The cleaning station is around 20 meters, where the rocks meet a white sandy bottom, perfect spot to watch mantas gliding into the rocks. Though mantas are the main attraction of this site, Manta Alley it is also full of marine life including reef sharks, schools of trevallies and large wrasses. The corals are very beautiful and diverse as well, making this spot a spectacular background for marine life photography.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Maravilla, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. The cenote is a sinkhole in the shape of a bell, where the entrance is a hole in the middle of the top. The thick sulfur cloud offers views that look from another planet. Getting close to this cloud is necessary to observe the gorgeous living stalactites, the biothems often called “Hell’s bells.” Those mysterious rock formations are alive and grow underwater thanks to extraordinary endemic bacteria. This type of speleothems, called “elephant feet,” has been found in only 4 cenotes, all in the Puerto Morelos area and are subject to ongoing scientific research.

programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Kecil, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. The best time to dive this site is when the current is running! This is a real rollercoaster of a ride and will often be referred to as the 'Superman drift'. This gorgeous coral reef with a stunning overhang has a fast moving current - nothing scary just a great drift along. No need to kick! Towards the end of the dive site you drift towards and more sheltered area and the current eases off. Here you can relax (catch your breath!), and admire the stunning hard corals and thousands on anthias. This is also a great spot for seeing hawksbill turtles. The strong currents of this dive site attract large fish including giant trevally, barracuda, tuna, sharks and the odd ray too! The overhangs provide a fascinating topography and if the current allows they are great to explore and hunt for nurse sharks, bamboo sharks and other bizarre creatures.

programme.title: Batu Bolong north, Komodo, Indonesia
programme.desc: You are about to go on a fascinating journey through the amazing underwater world of Batu Bolong. As you watch this remarkable documentary, you will discover the wonderful beauty and diversity of life below the waves. Located within Indonesia's Komodo National Park, Batu Bolong's exposed rock pinnacle reveals a hidden paradise full of marine wonders. Despite challenges like changing currents and depths, you will learn how expert divers navigate the currents and explore different depths, from shallow coral gardens to tall walls. You will see the vibrant underwater dance of reef fish, including colorful groupers, moray eels, and majestic emperor fish. You will encounter the mysterious white tip reef shark, marvel at its unique anatomy, and understand its interesting behaviors. As the documentary reveals the top predator, the giant trevally, you will be captivated by its striking features and hunting skills. You will delve into the complex relationships within the ecosystem, from cleaner fish caring for their companions to the vital role of table corals in sheltering marine life. Immerse yourself in this kaleidoscope of colors, shapes, and behaviors, and let the enchanting beauty of Batu Bolong's underwater world leave you longing for more, ready to return to this aquatic oasis time and again.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Angelita, Tulum, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Angelita is located 10 kilometers west of Tulum. Angelita is a magical cenote that is often described as mysterious and a bit spooky. At first, the cenote appears to be unassuming, just a small pond in the middle of a very thick jungle. However, the deepest parts of the cenote go down to 204 ft (66 m). Its most amazing feature is a 4.5 ft (1.5 m) thick hydrogen sulfide cloud that starts at 83 ft (27 m). This cloud is made up of gases that have leaked out of decomposing trees and leaves that fall from the jungle into the cenote. This gas accumulates where the fresh and the salt water meet (the halocline). This creates a false floor at the bottom, which can be traversed to reach a dark, otherworldly chamber that is full of jungle detritus. The base of this mountain of detritus starts below but reaches above the cloud. Rising again from below the cloud, the peak of the mountain of detritus takes on a new face, as if one is ascending a cloud-topped mountain. On the way out of the cenote, there is a small cave loop, and at the surface, one can get an appreciation for all of the trees that provide this cenote with its hydrogen sulfide cloud.

programme.title: Dive Site Paradise Reef, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.desc: Paradise Reef dive site is located in the west of Cozumel. Paradise Reef is the first reef when entering the Marine Park. The current runs from south to north normally. You will start across from the entrance to the Caleta and drift north. There are 2-3 coral ridges that parallel the shoreline. You can see schools of Grunts, Snappers, and Sergeant Majors, many Queen Angelfish. There are nice coral heads ranging from 3-6m tall that jut out from a sandy bottom. You can find anemones, and an assortment of nice sponges clinging to the coral heads. Just about every kind of fish from the area can be found here. Some of the bigger animals include barracuda and grouper. Keep a close eye for the small denizens such as Spotted Drum, Smooth Trunkfish, Spotted Moray Eels, and Spiny Lobster.

programme.title: Lawalaut Island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Lawalaut Island is located northeast of Gili Lawa Darat Island. Gili Lawa Laut is understandably a magnet for visitors on land and sea. The island is in the Lesser Sunda Islands and sits to the north of Komodo Island and the other small islet of Gili Lawa Daret and as such is protected as part of the Komodo National Park. Geologically the islets are volcanic like much of the region and they have beautiful hills popular with hikers who come for the stunning views and secluded beaches. The island is uninhabited but has numerous trails for walking up the hills to see the surrounding area. The wildlife above water is slightly less of a draw than the sea life on this island as there is less vegetation than in other areas. The hills are grassy though, and the landscape is very beautiful and a popular photography spot for visitors to the national park.

programme.title: Arborek Island, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua. It is easily walkable on foot, taking roughly thirty minutes to walk the entire coastline. The island is known for its very hospitable tourism village and exceptional handicrafts with a thriving souvenir community. Be ready to be greeted with open arms by everyone, with many children who are eager to be photographed. This authentic island welcomes guests with pride, the islanders are happy to introduce all to the Papuan culture and unique traditional foods. It is a perfect paradise to learn a bit of the Asai culture, which is still kept alive in this isolated place. Arborek island, traditionally a mooring spot for boatmen, is surrounded by splendid sago palms, nourished by fish and it is sparsely populated by a tiny population of around 200 residents, spread in around 40 families. The water is crystal clear, with white fine sand and many coconut trees and bushes, providing a quite comforting and refreshing atmosphere. At the wooden pier you will find some gazebos, ideal for relaxing.

programme.title: Dive Site Yucab, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.desc: Yucab dive site is located in front of Mia beach in the west of Cozumel. There is a huge concentration of marine life which covers this reef. There are sponges everywhere and of every color. The sand scoured overhangs offer refuge for lobsters, banded coral shrimps and the arrow crab. There are also large numbers of squirrelfish, angel and butterflyfish always swimming in pairs. This is a great site for photographers.

programme.title: Dive Site Paso Del Cedral, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.desc: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel. Also called Cedral Wall it is one of the most beautiful dive sites in Cozumel. It can be done as a wall dive or closer to shore over the reef. The part of the reef that is not a wall, consists of a mile of sloping hills covered in sponges and coral. The reef bottoms out at about 18 meters (60 feet). As for the current, it's generally moderate to strong. As you drift you'll get to see eagle rays, lobsters, hawksbill turtles, green morays, big pufferfish, toadfish, and even sharks.

programme.title: Dive Site Citrus Ridge, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: Citrus Ridge dive site is located in the channel between Yanggefo and Gam Islands. A reef slope covered with mostly orange and purple soft corals. One of north Raja’s most colorful reefs. Deeper channel (Gam) side of reef usually has good schooling fish action. This reef has it all, reef fish, schooling pelagics, colorful bommies, wobbegong sharks, turtles, macro life. An outstanding dive!

programme.title: Dive Site San Clemente, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.desc: San Clemente dive site is located in the south west of Cozumel. San Clemente Reef is a beginner diver's dream, with shallow depth between 10 meters and 15 meters and little current. As it is located between the Yucab Reef and the Tormentos Reef, San Clemente shares plenty of similarities with these two dive sites. Divers can encounter here spotted moray eels, butterflyfish swimming in pairs, groupers, snappers, grunts, scorpionfish, angelfish, seahorses hidden in the grass, damselfish, cowfish, eagle rays, filefish, barracudas. This dive spot has a mostly sandy bottom with coral outcrops and patches.

programme.title: Dive Site Blue Magic, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: Blue Magic dive site is situated between the island of Kri and the main island of Waisai, in the Dampier Strait. programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Zapote, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. Cenote Zapote is named after the Sapote trees growing nearby. It is located on the “Ruta de los Cenotes” the old road from Puerto Morelos to Valladolid. Zapote has quite a deep drop from the land surface to the water surface of 6m/20ft but its access is easy via stairs. The walls will rise above you like a fortress and once you start your descent they become narrower until a depth of 20m/66ft before starting to open back up again. Once you reach a depth of 30m/100ft you will be above the talus cone in a bell shaped chamber with a narrow skylight in the top through which you just descended. Halocline and a thin misty layer of Hydrogen Sulfide floating on top of it, as well as some of the most amazing and incredible formations commonly described as bells, elephant feet, shower heads or trumpets will truly take your breath away with their strange beauty and impressive size.

programme.title: Dive Site Saporkren at Night, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai. This site is typically dived at night, however day diving is good too. Saporkren is your typical sandy bottom muck dive site, which is a little grubby since its just off of the village jetty. Making your way down a gentle slope (with little or no current) past a few coral bommies, the best bit of Saporkren is generally around 12-20 metres. We found full-size seahorses, cute bobtail squid, flying flatworms, clownfish anemones, colemani shrimp plus many unusual crabs species such as the boxer, xeno and porcelain.

programme.title: Padar island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island. Padar is the third largest island in the Komodo National Park. It is located in the south central of the park, between Komodo and Rinca Island. In the past, Padar was one of the island in Komodo where there were dragons live. Along with the illegal hunting activities by human being, they are slowly disappeared and almost unable to see them anymore. The cause is simply because of the lack of foods, like deer and wild boar. Their extinction can be because they just died alone without any food to eat or prolonged hunger or they can be migrated to nearest island, Rinca. The island now remains empty with no dragons. However, other wild animals such as wild boars are still around daily. Today, Padar has become one of the most popular place to visit in Indonesia. It offers super magnificent view from the top of the island with pink sandy beach on the west side and white sandy beach on the east side. Formation of towering hill, just like Jurassic park. Although the island has no dragons existed, the island is one of the best charming spot of trekking. Those who love photographic, this is perhaps the best place for spectacular photos.

programme.title: Dive Site C56 Shipwreck, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos. The C-56 shipwreck served in World War II and it was sold to the Mexican Marine in 1966. The time pass by and later on 28th Oct 2000 was purposefully sunk, as a new attraction for divers coming to the Riviera Maya. Laying perfectly upright, with the keel on the sand at 90ft, the 184ft long Mexican Gun Boat was quickly inhabited by various marine life. The deck, at 64ft, is teeming with life and it's common to see a large shoal of Big Eye Travellies hunting there. As we travel around the wreck we commonly see large Wrasse, Groupers, Morays and, looking up, flights of Eagle Rays. Soft corals have colonized the wreck and now offer a home to many Arrow crabs and Fire worms amongst other small crustaceans and invertebrates.

programme.title: Sumidero Canyon, Tuxtla Gutiérrez , Mexico
programme.desc: Sumidero Canyon is located just north of the city of Tuxtla Gutiérrez. Sumidero Canyon (Spanish: Cañón del Sumidero) is a deep natural canyon which creation began around the same time as the Grand Canyon in the U.S. by a crack in the area's crust and subsequent erosion by the Grijalva River, which still runs through it. Sumidero Canyon has vertical walls which reach as high as 1,000 metres, with the river turning up to 90 degrees during the 13 kilometre length of the narrow passage.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Dos Ojos, Tulum, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Dos Ojos is located 15 kilometers north of Tulum. Dos Ojos (Two Eyes) refers to two neighboring cenotes that are connected by a large cavern that also connects to a subterranean river. The original explorations of this water system, one of the largest in the world, started in the Dos Ojos cenotes. The total length of the combined system was measured at 310.95 kilometers (193.22 mi). This cenote dive site consists of two independent circuits: The first dive starts at the Barbie Line, a 415 meters line with wide spaces and large light galleries. The second dive circuit is called the Bat Cave, a very different experience. The Bat Cave is an adjacent cenote, next to Dos Ojos, and represents a much more preserved environment, mainly due the fact that the roof of the cenote hasn’t collapsed yet and all of the formations around it are in very good shape.

programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Besar, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Siaba Besar dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar dive site is a sheltered bay with coral seamounts and amazing coral reefs, located in the North-West side of the island. The reef is 4-6 meters deep with healthy corals and sand patches around. It has a massive coral garden and lacks strong currents, but it does not mean it lacks cool sights and marine life, just the opposite! This feature makes Siaba Besar a suitable dive site for any kind of level, being the best place for those who have never dived and want to try this amazing experience in Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar is heaven for snorkelers, given its easy conditions with shallow coral reefs, very little current and abundant marine life. A superlative snorkeling among sea turtles it is guaranteed, which gives the nickname to this site: Turtle City

programme.title: Dive Site Manta Point, Nusa Penida, Indonesia
programme.desc: In this episode, you will explore Manta Point, located in Nusa Penida, Bali, Indonesia, and learn about its remarkable marine inhabitants. Manta Point, situated on Nusa Penida's southwest coast, is renowned for its resident Manta ray colony, making it a must-visit dive site. Divers of all levels are drawn to its diverse range of underwater experiences, including reef exploration, photography, training, and fish identification. Notable species found here include the day octopus and the tawny nurse shark, both captivating creatures. Manta rays, particularly the Manta alfredi species, gracefully glide through the water with their distinctive pectoral fins and are often seen at cleaning stations, where cleaner fish help them rid parasites. However, these majestic creatures face threats from overfishing and human impacts. Manta Point offers an extraordinary underwater adventure, showcasing the beauty and diversity of marine life in this region.

programme.title: The Komodo dragons of south Rinca, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area is well known to be one of the best place to see wild Komodo dragons. The Komodo dragon (Varanus komodoensis), also known as the Komodo monitor, is a member of the monitor lizard family Varanidae that is endemic to the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang. It is the largest extant species of lizard, growing to a maximum length of 3 metres, and weighing up to approximately 70 kilograms. As a result of their size, Komodo dragons are apex predators, and dominate the ecosystems in which they live. Komodo dragons hunt and ambush prey including invertebrates, birds, and mammals. It has been claimed that they have a venomous bite; there are two glands in the lower jaw that secrete several toxic proteins. The biological significance of these proteins is disputed, but the glands have been shown to secrete an anticoagulant. Komodo dragons' group behavior in hunting is exceptional in the reptile world. The diet of Komodo dragons mainly consists of Javan rusa (Rusa timorensis), though they also eat considerable amounts of carrion. Komodo dragons also occasionally attack humans.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

How Not to Die exposes the role of the standard Western diet in fueling today’s most widespread illnesses. The film offers jaw-dropping, but evidence-based, insights into the prevention of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, kidney disease, liver dysfunction, and a spectrum of brain disorders, including dementia and Alzheimer’s disease. It also addresses how diet influences the development of colon, prostate, and other digestive cancers, delivering life-saving information with clarity and authority.

Venere depuis des siecles, il possede une grande importance religieuse, notamment dans la tradition chretienne comme lieu de la Transfiguration, et offre des vues panoramiques impressionnantes sur le paysage environnant.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

After half a century of migration, mainly in one direction, there is a new current flowing back to the East thanks to the economic boom in China.

programme.title: Impostora
programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

Le site est proche des sources perennes de la riviere Yarkon et fait desormais partie du parc national de Yarkon en Israel. programme.title: Swimmers

programme.desc: The Explorers le cuentan la historia de una región del sureste de Francia, rica en contrastes... La historia de una región imposible de resumir en una sola palabra, por la infinita variedad de sus paisajes y culturas. Es la región Sur, también conocida como Provenza-Alpes-Costa Azul... Una región con tres caras.

programme.title: Bella Solitaria
programme.desc: Go Dok Mi es una editora de libros, bastante tímida, se niega a abandonar su apartamento o interactuar con la gente de su alrededor lo mayor posible. Cada día, ella recibe de forma anónima una caja de leche con un Post-it pegado, el que sigue una historia uno tras otro. Todos los días, usando un par de binoculares de color amarillo ella mira a su vecino de enfrente, Han Tae Joon. La última vez que estuvo fuera, fue en un parque en un día de otoño, se había enamorado de Tae Joon, a primera vista, lo continuo mirando y se dio cuenta que adoptó un perro. Cuando miró por la ventana y vio que el vivía en el apartamento de al frente, ella lo asocio al destino.

programme.title: Youth Topia
programme.desc: In Valpolvra, a village that has fallen out of time, self-actualization is the focus of all the inhabitants. Their dream jobs are reliably determined by an algorithm. The adolescents are spared the previously endless orientation phase of youth, the search for the perfect job, the many rejections and all other crises of meaning. Instead, everyone lives a fulfilled and productive life.

programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.title: Adam Ondra: Pushing the Limits

programme.desc: Buzzing with lust for adventure, a musician from Dublin and his band move to Berlin. Oisín leaves behind the weight of losing his mother, and anger towards his absent father. Oisín meets Sabine, a pretty Berliner who shows him the city's secret places: cool parks, deserted subway stations, skinny dipping lakes in the countryside.

programme.title: Les Chemins De L'ecole
programme.sub-title: Le chemin de l'ecole d'Israel - San Luis Potosi
programme.desc: Ces enfants vivent aux quatre coins du globe mais partagent la meme soif d’apprendre. Ils ont compris que seule l’instruction leur permettra d’ameliorer leur vie, et c’est pour cela que chaque jour, dans des paysages incroyables, ils se lancent dans un periple a haut risque qui les conduira vers le savoir.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Sudáfrica
programme.desc: Savane Sauvage. Desde las montañas Drakensberg hasta el océano Índico, pasando por la sabana, la expedición The Explorers sigue el rastro de los "Cinco Grandes" y su salvaje procesión.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Nouvelle Calédonie, au Pays des Merveilles de la Terre
programme.desc: The Explorers, menée par Olivier Chiabodo, a déployé ses équipes pour réaliser, en images, l’inventaire des merveilles naturelles d'une terre découverte par l’explorateur anglais James Cook en 1774 : la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Mais également découvrir la culture des premiers habitants de l'île, les Mélanésiens.

programme.title: Rocket Perelman
programme.desc: The gimmicks in the fashion industry got on Jen's nerves (Liv Lisa Fries). So she goes on the road looking for new horizons and ends up at the "Rocket Perelman", a commune in the Brandenburg sand box, where a different way of life is preached by Tobias (Tobias Lehmann): live free, be creative and follow your instincts.

programme.title: Bethphage, Israel (Partie 2)
programme.desc: Bethphage est le point de depart de l’entree triomphale de Jesus a Jerusalem le dimanche des Rameaux. Le village de Bethphage est situe entre Bethanie et le mont des Oliviers dans la ville sainte de Jerusalem. Il est marque par l’eglise de Bethphage, qui contient une pierre traditionnellement identifiee comme celle sur laquelle Jesus est monte pour commencer sa procession a Jerusalem.

programme.title: Un Amor Duradero
programme.desc: La historia sigue a dos personas diferentes, Andeng (Bea Alonzo) y Anton (Ian Veneracion), que demostrarán que dos corazones rotos pueden hacer que su amor dure o no.

programme.title: Les Chemins De L'ecole
programme.sub-title: Le chemin de l'ecole de Kritika - Nepal
programme.desc: Ces enfants vivent aux quatre coins du globe mais partagent la meme soif d’apprendre. Ils ont compris que seule l’instruction leur permettra d’ameliorer leur vie, et c’est pour cela que chaque jour, dans des paysages incroyables, ils se lancent dans un periple a haut risque qui les conduira vers le savoir.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Islas Marquesas
programme.desc: The Explorers atraviesa la inmensidad de Sudáfrica, desde el desierto del Kalahari hasta la meseta central, pasando por los parques Kruger e Isimangaliso.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Arctique Canadien
programme.desc: Le règne du blanc. Les membres de l'expédition The Explorers partent à la découverte de l'Arctique canadien, une région emblématique du bouleversement climatique qui touche notre planète. Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Tiempo para nuestro cuerpo y mente
programme.desc: Patricia Torres nos ilustra acerca del reiki y lo eterico acopañamos una sesion de Reiki, con terapia de cuarzos y otros elementos ancestrales

programme.title: In die Welt - Into the World
programme.desc: In all its intensity and diversity, the everyday miracle of birth is shown with the means of direct cinema, without commentary, interviews or explanation, and connected to the cycle of standardized processes in the Viennese hospital. A chronicle of the beginning of life and its organization.

programme.title: Eglise Saint Jean-Baptiste, Israel
programme.desc: Une promenade dans le charmant village d’Ein Kerem, situe sur les pentes occidentales de Jerusalem, pour decouvrir l’eglise Saint Jean-Baptiste, egalement connue sous le nom de Saint Jean-Baptiste BaHarim, ce qui signifie Saint Jean-Baptiste dans les montagnes en hebreu.

programme.title: Beyhadh
programme.desc: Maya es una joven magnate de los negocios que ha triunfado en el mundo corporativo. Ella se enamora perdidamente de Arjun, un apuesto galán que ama la fotografía. En la misma empresa trabaja Saanjh, una bella joven enamoradiza.

programme.title: Tiempo para nuestro cuerpo y mente

programme.title: Indonesia: Bosques de lo extraño
programme.desc: Los Exploradores se adentran en un mundo extraño y desconcertante en los últimos bosques de Indonesia. Los árboles son el epítome de la rareza, como las higueras estranguladoras: estos gigantes asfixian al árbol que los cobija y al mismo tiempo dan cobijo a una fauna increíble.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: Lukasz (24) wants to get out of crisis mode. He yearns for recognition and loyalty. As tough thug for Hamburg's main man, he believes he's found it all. While Lukasz's rise up the ladder begins to take shape, the death of their mother brings his little brother Kamil (13) to Lukasz's front door after a long break in contact.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Nio Battery-Swap
programme.desc: Der chinesische Autohersteller Nio geht das Thema "E-Auto laden" anders an als die Konkurrenz. In sogenannten Battery-Swap-Stations soll der Akku innerhalb von nur fünf Minuten gewechselt werden. Ist das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität? Alexander Bloch testet die Anlage und klärt die 9 größten Irrtümer zum Akkuwechsel beim E-Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Golf 7
programme.desc: Der VW Golf 7 ist eines der meistverkauften und beliebtesten Modelle des Volkswagenkonzerns. Worauf man beim Kauf eines gebrauchten Golf 7 achten muss erklärt Alexander Bloch. Egal ob Probleme mit dem AGR-Ventil, dem DSG-Getriebe und Rost, die Schwachstellen und guten Seiten des Wolfsburger Dauerbrenners kommen hier zum Vorschein.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 1.000.000 Kilometer
programme.desc: In der 100. Folge von Bloch erklärt kümmert sich Alex um das Thema Dauerläufer: Wie hält dein Auto ewig? Im Mittelpunkt steht ein Lexus LS400 mit einer Million Kilometer auf der Uhr. Wie fährt sich so ein Kilometerfresser eigentlich? Und was muss man tun, damit das eigene Auto auch das Zeug zum Dauerläufer hat? Alex Bloch erklärt euch 10 wichtige Regeln - das wird gut!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Autos 2023
programme.desc: Die Lieferzeiten bei Elektroautos sind lang. Doch zumindest wird 2023 die Auswahl deutlich größer. Besonders die chinesischen Hersteller wollen angreifen und zeigen zahlreiche Neuheiten. Aber auch die deutschen Produzenten legen nach. Alexander Bloch zeigt seine 10 Highlights für das Jahr 2023. Hier seht ihr seine Favoriten.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Sicherheits-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Welche Autos sind am sichersten? Welche Aussagekraft haben Crashtests überhaupt? Warum spielt die Farbe eines Autos in der Unfallstatistik eine Rolle? Die Antwort auf diese Fragen und weitere spannende Informationen rund um das Thema Verkehrssicherheit gibt es in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt. Zudem findet Alexander Bloch unter den Testdummies einen neuen Freund: Thor!

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Absima Sherpa RC: Alex vs. Lance
programme.desc: Neuauflage des RC-Duells zwischen Alex Bloch und Lance David Arnold. Auf der Strecke des RCRT Duisburg geht es heute nicht um Schnelligkeit, sondern genaues fahren. Wer schafft den Trail-Parcous fehlerfrei mit seinem Absima Sherpa?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Fendt 1050 Vario-Teil 2
programme.desc: Unter der Motorhaube des größten Standard-Traktor der Welt brummt ein 12,4-Liter-Reihensechszylinder-Diesel. Alexander Bloch fährt den Fendt 1050 Vario auf der Teststrecke Probe. Außerdem wartet eine kleine Herausforderung auf Alex, die viel Fingerspitzengefühl erfordert.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Carrera Bahn
programme.desc: Sie ist einer der Spiele-Klassiker und darf in keinem Kinderzimmer eines echten Petrolheads fehlen: Die Carrera Bahn. Doch wie genau funktioniert die Bahn? Welche Technik wird eingesetzt? Und was kann man optimieren? Das alles und noch viel Mehr bei Bloch spielt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Fendt 1050 Vario-Teil 1
programme.desc: Fendt 1050 Vario: der stärkste Standard-Traktor der Welt! Er leistet beachtliche 517 PS und 2.420 Newtonmeter Drehmoment. Wie der Gigant produziert wird und welche technischen Raffinessen er zu bieten hat, schaut sich Alexander Bloch in den heiligen Hallen von Fendt an.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - VW ID.7 Effizienzcheck (Teil 1)
programme.desc: Alex Bloch checkt den neuen VW ID.7 und weiht Euch in die Geheimnisse seines Antriebs ein. Die große Frage: Wie effizient kann ein Elektromotor sein und was kann man machen um ihn effizienter zu bekommen?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - VW ID.7 Effizienzcheck (Teil 2)
programme.desc: Alex Bloch darf den VW ID.7 fahren und erklärt Euch im Detail, was die neue vollelektrische Limousine von Volkswagen kann.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 8 Todsünden beim Winterreifen-Wechsel
programme.desc: Noch sind die Temperaturen mild, doch so langsam sollte der Wechsel auf Winterreifen erfolgen. Oder setzt ihr auf Allwetter-Reifen? Alex Bloch klärt die 8 Todsünden beim Wechsel auf wintertaugliche Reifen.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Die 5 größten Fehler bei VW unter Diess
programme.desc: Ob Qualität oder Bedienung: In verschiedenen einstigen Paradedisziplinen hat VW den Anschluss an die Konkurrenz verloren. Mit dafür verantwortlich: Herbert Diess. Als Vorstandsvorsitzender der Volkswagen AG hat er den Konzern ins Elektro-Auto-Zeitalter geführt. Dabei hat er vieles angeschoben, aber auch einige Baustellen hinterlassen. Alex Bloch beleuchtet die Fehler unter Diess und welche Baustellen VW in Zukunft angehen muss.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Die 10 Gebote des guten Tunings: SO tunt ihr richtig!
programme.desc: Tuning geht über rein äußerliche Veränderungen hinaus. Es handelt sich um eine Kombination von Modifikationen, die nicht nur die Optik, sondern auch das Fahrverhalten eines Fahrzeugs verbessern sollen. Das Ziel: eine ausgewogene und beherrschbare Performance. Alexander Bloch zeigt, worauf es beim Tuning ankommt am Beispiel des Steeda Mustang Q767 Mach 1.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Warum Rennwagen für die Zukunft wichtig sind
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch besucht das VDI-Racing-Camp powered by norelem und erklärt 5 Gründe, wieso die Formula Student wichtig für die Zukunft des Autos ist.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Performance Tesla
programme.desc: Elon Musk und Tesla haben in der Vergangenheit schon so manche Leistungsversprechen abgegeben, bei denen einem regelrecht schwindelig wird. Einige davon sind eingetreten, andere aber eben nicht. Im zweiten Teil zu Tesla-Versprechungen nimmt Alex die Performance Angaben ganz genau unter die Lupe. Er erklärt, warum manche Angaben zu Leistung, Beschleunigung und Rennstreckenperformance mit Vorsicht zu genießen sind.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Verbrenner - Elektro
programme.desc: Der Verbrennungsmotor wird auf den Straßen Stück für Stück vom Elektromotor abgelöst. Dennoch sind Diesel und Benziner noch immer ein wichtiger Bestandteil der Mobilität. Doch wie steht es um die Effizienz der Verbrennungsmotoren? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 5 größten Effizienz-Irrtümer.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Getriebeirrtümer
programme.desc: Getriebe sind aus Autos nicht wegzudenken: Doch es gibt viele Irrtümer zu Getrieben, egal ob Schalter oder Automatik. Alex klärt die wichtigsten Irrtümer

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Apocalypse Earth - Apocalisse Sulla Terra
programme.desc: In seguito a un'invasione aliena, un gruppo di umani disperati fuggono dalla Terra e arrivano in un pianeta lontano. I rifugiati si ritroveranno ben presto a dover combattere per la propria sopravvivenza contro feroci e ostili creature.

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: Alienate - Lotta Per La Terra
programme.desc: Ormai alla fine del suo matrimonio, David parte per un viaggio di lavoro per dare alla moglie un po' di spazio. Tuttavia, quando gli aerei cominciano a cadere misteriosamente dal cielo, si ritrova intrappolato in un'invasione aliena.

programme.title: Frontier - Ai Confini Del Tempo
programme.desc: Il giovane e cinico Mikhail ha dedicato tutta la sua vita al lavoro sacrificando ogni tipo di relazione, fin quando un incontro con una donna e l'apertura di un misterioso portale gli fanno rimettere in discussione tutta la sua esistenza.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, un virus di proporzioni epiche ha devastato il pianeta Terra, dove il numero degli infetti supera quello delle persone sane e l'unica speranza è trovare una cura per sconfiggere l'epidemia. La dottoressa Lauren Chase ha un obiettivo ben preciso: portare la sua squadra sul campo e salvare il maggior numero di sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Martian Land - Tempesta Su Marte
programme.desc: Nel futuro, la razza umana si è trasferita su Marte e vive in città simili a quelle terrestri, ma protette da enormi campi di forza. Quando una gigantesca tempesta di sabbia sfonda la cupola e distrugge completamente Mars New York, gli abitanti di Mars Los Angeles dovranno cercare di fermare la tempesta, prima di essere i prossimi ad essere spazzati via.

programme.title: Age Of Tomorrow
programme.desc: La Terra è invasa da Ufo che distruggono tutto quello che si muove. Mentre la battaglia infuria, un gruppo di astronauti riesce a entrare nella nave principale dove uno di loro scopre un portale che conduce al mondo degli alieni. Riesce appena ad avvertire qualcuno dei suoi superiori sulla Terra, prima che tutto il gruppo venga ucciso. Parte l'ultimo disperato tentativo per fermare l'invasione.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. programme.title: Absolon: Virus Mortale
programme.desc: Un virus ha infettato l'intera umanità e l'Absolon è un farmaco indispensabile per sopravvivere. Un agente di polizia inizia a indagare sull'omicidio di uno scienziato che stava lavorando a un antidoto contro il virus, arrivando a scoprire una cospirazione. Da quel momento diviene il bersaglio della società che monopolizza l'Absolon.

programme.title: Un Natale Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Action movie ambientato tra i ghiacci dell’Alaska con Brendan Fehr e Jodelle Ferland. Siamo alla Vigilia di Natale e l’idillio delle feste viene bruscamente interrotto quando i ghiacciai, sciogliendosi, iniziano a rilasciare grandi quantità di metano liquido che, se non fermato, rischia di far esplodere l'intero pianeta.

programme.title: Icetastrophe
programme.desc: Un meteorite entra nell'atmosfera terrestre e si spezza a metà. Un pezzo colpisce il centro di Lennox, negli Stati Uniti, e subito dopo l'area circostante inizia a congelarsi; l'altro ha creato una nuova zona tropicale. L' umanità potrebbe salvarsi solo con il ricongiungimento delle due metà.

programme.title: 100 Gradi Sottozero - Trappola Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Un fan ossessionato e sua madre rapiscono delle ex "reginette dell'urlo" e le costringono a rimettere in scena i loro famosi ruoli cinematografici... con risultati letali.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. Amid commodity volatility and fractured supply chains, electrification is no longer a question of “if” but “how fast.” As the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) market and a major force of global EV sales, how is China shaping the pace and direction of this charge towards greener, smarter vehicles? Join us on BizTalk this week as we explore how China and Germany are moving in step toward the next phase of the future of mobility.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: The Rite Society
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing’s merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing’s rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Ancient Ru Kiln embraces its new era
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: Exploring Ethnic Attire: Dong Elegance
programme.desc: Dong clothing weaves together tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique identity of the Dong ethnic group. In this episode, we’ll unravel the stories behind the intricate designs, vibrant colors, and deep cultural significance of Dong attire. From ceremonial garments to everyday wear, each piece is imbued with the essence of a rich heritage.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Inseparability of Things
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”
